_readme: When Frag Fridays actually runs, Sydney time. THE one place to say it.
The slot moves week to week, so it's one entry per Friday: start is the
scheduled kickoff, end is when the slot is over. A Friday with no entry
uses "default", so an ordinary week needs no edit - and an unlisted week
can never silently inherit last week's odd time.
scripts/standings.py                      log window for the leaderboards
Changing a past week's times re-cuts its leaderboard: scripts/standings.sh
replays the whole log archive every run. Warm-up before start and play
after end land in the practice table, not the session.
